comment: Roles and kinds of bench/labels/guideline.md, read by bench/R/score-labels.R (roles and kinds) and by the label workbench (also the questions and hints). The guideline is the authority: change it first, with a dated entry, then this file. `examples` of a kind: leaves of the guideline's worked examples (figure and k of bench/labels/examples, elements for a part of a leaf), from the guideline's table and in its order; the workbench shows them beside the kind and refuses to start if one is not labelled so.

roles.question: Is its position or content computed from rows?
roles.question_zh: 位置或内容是从数据行算出来的吗？

kinds.hint: a symbol at a row's position (scatter, jitter, outliers of a boxplot, dot plot)
kinds.hint_zh: 落在某一行位置上的符号：散点、抖动点、箱线图离群点

kinds.hint: a path through several rows (line, step, fitted line, density curve, ROC curve, the edges of a band)
kinds.hint_zh: 穿过多行的线：折线、拟合线、密度曲线、ROC 曲线、带的边线

kinds.hint: a filled region drawn from rows (area, ribbon, confidence band, density fill, violin, map polygon)
kinds.hint_zh: 由数据行画出的填充区域：面积、置信带、密度填充、小提琴、地图多边形

kinds.hint: a rectangle from a baseline to a value (bar, column, histogram bin)
kinds.hint_zh: 从基线到数值的矩形：柱、条、直方图的一格

kinds.hint: a rectangle or raster in a grid of them (tile, raster, heatmap body cell, heatmap annotation cell, hexagon)
kinds.hint_zh: 网格里的一格：tile、栅格、热图格子、热图注释格子、六边形

kinds.hint: a straight piece per row or per pair of rows (segment, error bar, whisker, line range, rug, dendrogram branch, a data label's leader line, a computed comparison bracket)
kinds.hint_zh: 每行（或每对行）一段直线：线段、误差线、箱线图的须、rug、树状图分支、数据标签的引线、算出来的比较括号

kinds.hint: the box and median of a boxplot, a crossbar
kinds.hint_zh: 箱线图的箱体和中位线、crossbar

kinds.hint: text whose content or position comes from rows (data labels, repelled labels, counts on bars, values in heatmap cells, computed p-values)
kinds.hint_zh: 内容或位置来自数据行的文字：数据标签、避让标签、柱上的计数、格子里的数值、算出来的 p 值

kinds.hint: say what it is in the note
kinds.hint_zh: 其他数据标记，在备注里写明是什么

roles.question: Does it tell the reader how to read the data marks?
roles.question_zh: 它是在告诉读者怎么读数据标记吗？（坐标轴、图例、分面标签）

kinds.hint: an axis's line
kinds.hint_zh: 坐标轴的轴线

kinds.hint: an axis's tick marks
kinds.hint_zh: 坐标轴的刻度线

kinds.hint: an axis's tick labels; a heatmap's row and column names
kinds.hint_zh: 刻度上的文字；热图的行名、列名

kinds.hint: an axis's title; the name of a heatmap annotation track
kinds.hint_zh: 坐标轴标题；热图注释轨道的名字

kinds.hint: the glyph of a legend entry, whatever its shape
kinds.hint_zh: 图例条目的图样，不论是点、线、方块还是字母 a

kinds.hint: a legend entry's text
kinds.hint_zh: 图例条目的文字

kinds.hint: a legend's title
kinds.hint_zh: 图例的标题

kinds.hint: a continuous legend's bar (its rectangles or raster) and its ticks
kinds.hint_zh: 连续图例的色条（它的小矩形或栅格）和色条上的刻度线

kinds.hint: text naming a facet panel, or a slice of a split heatmap
kinds.hint_zh: 分面面板的名字；切分热图里某一片的名字

kinds.hint: say what it is in the note
kinds.hint_zh: 其他引导元素，在备注里写明是什么

roles.question: Is it a line or band at a typed value that helps read positions?
roles.question_zh: 它是画在代码里写死的值上、帮人读位置的线或带吗？

kinds.hint: a panel's grid lines (major and minor), base grid(), a map's graticule
kinds.hint_zh: 面板的网格线（主、次）、base 的 grid()、地图经纬网

kinds.hint: a line at a typed value (geom_hline(yintercept = 0), abline(h = 20), a ROC plot's diagonal)
kinds.hint_zh: 画在写死的值上的线：geom_hline(yintercept = 0)、abline(h = 20)、ROC 图的对角线

kinds.hint: a band at typed values that spans the panel
kinds.hint_zh: 画在写死的值上、横贯面板的带

roles.question: Did the author type both its content and its position?
roles.question_zh: 内容和位置都是作者手写的吗？

kinds.hint: title, subtitle, caption, tag, base main; a heatmap's column or row title when that dimension is not split
kinds.hint_zh: 标题、副标题、caption、tag、base 的 main；热图某个维度没有切分时，它的行标题或列标题

kinds.hint: other typed text (annotate("text"), base text() or mtext() with typed strings that are not axis titles)
kinds.hint_zh: 其他手写的文字：annotate("text")、base 的 text()/mtext() 里写死的字符串（不是坐标轴标题）

kinds.hint: a typed shape (annotate("rect") or annotate("segment") placed by hand, a typed arrow or bracket)
kinds.hint_zh: 手放的形状：annotate("rect")、annotate("segment")、手写的箭头或括号

roles.question: Otherwise: it carries no information.
roles.question_zh: 以上都不是：不带信息的背景、边框

kinds.hint: a filled rectangle behind other elements (plot, panel, legend, legend key, strip backgrounds; a base legend's filled box)
kinds.hint_zh: 垫在别的元素后面的填充矩形：整图、面板、图例、图例键、分面条的背景；base 图例有填充的框

kinds.hint: an outline with no fill (panel border, base box(), a heatmap's border)
kinds.hint_zh: 没有填充的外框：面板边框、base 的 box()、热图的边框

kinds.hint: say what it is in the note
kinds.hint_zh: 其他装饰，在备注里写明是什么

cases.en: Strip or slice background: decoration / background. Its text: guide / strip label.
cases.zh: 分面条（或热图切片）的背景：decoration / background；上面的文字：guide / strip label。

cases.en: Legend and key backgrounds: decoration / background. Every key glyph: guide / legend key. A base legend() box: decoration, background if filled, border if only an outline.
cases.zh: 图例和图例键的背景：decoration / background；每个键的图样：guide / legend key。base legend() 的框：有填充是 background，只有外框是 border。

cases.en: A base axis leaf draws the axis line, the ticks and the tick labels: all guide; give the kinds by element (press S).
cases.zh: base 的一个 axis 叶子同时画轴线、刻度线和刻度文字：都是 guide，按 S 逐个元素给种类。

cases.en: Base title(): main is annotation / title, the axis labels are guide / axis title. This is a split (press S).
cases.zh: base 的 title()：main 是 annotation / title，xlab、ylab 是 guide / axis title，要拆开标（按 S）。

cases.en: A heatmap's column (row) title: guide / strip label when the columns (rows) are split, annotation / title when they are not.
cases.zh: 热图的列（行）标题：列（行）被切分时是 guide / strip label，没切分时是 annotation / title。

cases.en: Repelled labels (ggrepel) and their segments: data / text and data / segment.
cases.zh: 避让标签（ggrepel）和它的引线：data / text 和 data / segment。

cases.en: Rugs and marginal plots (ggExtra, ggside): data, with the kinds of their marks; their axes are guide.
cases.zh: rug 和边缘图（ggExtra、ggside）：data，种类按它画的标记；它们的坐标轴是 guide。

cases.en: A line whose value comes from the data (a computed mean) is data; a value typed in the code, also inside a data frame typed in the code, is reference.
cases.zh: 线的取值来自数据（比如算出来的均值）是 data；取值是代码里写死的（包括写在代码里的小数据框）是 reference。

cases.en: A typed label drawn once per row (a constant label mapped over all rows) is annotation / text.
cases.zh: 同一个手写标签每行画一遍（常量标签映射到所有行）：annotation / text。

cases.en: Invisible elements (no stroke and no fill, zero size, clipped away) are labelled by what drew them, with 'invisible' in the note.
cases.zh: 看不见的元素（没有描边也没有填充、大小为零、被裁掉）：按画它的东西来标，备注写 invisible。

cases.en: Images, logos, rasters that are not data: decoration / other, with a note.
cases.zh: 不是数据的图片、logo、栅格：decoration / other，加备注。

cases.en: Unsure: give the role you think most likely and mark it unsure. Never leave a leaf unlabelled.
cases.zh: 拿不准：选你认为最可能的，再按 U 标记“拿不准”。不要留空。
